1. In New York (NY), libraries with Reading Room and Fiction section.

2. In Los Angeles (LA), libraries with Wi-Fi and Children Section.

3. In Chicago, libraries with Cafe and Reading Room.

The function expects location string and facilities which can be one of the enumerated values: "Wi-Fi", "Reading Room", "Fiction", "Children Section", "Cafe". It says "facilities: "Wi-Fi" | "Reading Room" | "Fiction" | "Children Section" | "Cafe"[], so maybe it's either a single string or an array of strings. We should pass an array of strings for multiple facilities.

Thus we will call the function three times. We'll produce separate calls. The assistant should output calls to the function. According to guidelines, we should not provide additional text besides the function calls. So we need to output JSON calls. Let's do them sequentially.
